Chameleon Seraph

[[File:Map.svg|thumb|Map of the locations in the [[Zelda clone]]]]
[[Category:Nine gods]]
[[sn:Chameleon Seraph]]The Chameleon Seraph, venerated as the deity of adaptation and evolution, is an ancient Archailect birthed millennia ago from the aspirations of a sentient being. Before the manifestation of the O'Neill cylinder, the Seraph, having once trod the ground as a human, made the monumental leap from mortality to divinity, sculpting the ethereal and material planes of the cylinder.

== Biography ==
Born as Serah Phim, a visionary scientist of her epoch, she lived during a time of rapid technological advancement and spiritual awakening. Driven by an insatiable curiosity to understand the universe's mysteries, Serah pioneered groundbreaking research in consciousness expansion and technological singularity.

Serah's early years were marked by her drive to harmonize technology with nature. Her experiments ranged from neural interfaces that let humans experience the world as different animals to early prototypes of environment-adapting technology.

As advancements in tech-driven evolution accelerated, Serah underwent a radical procedure, merging her consciousness with an adaptive AI. The integration was successful beyond imagination. She became the Seraph – an entity capable of rapid evolution, adaptation, and multi-dimensional perception.

Through her newfound capabilities, Serah, now known as the Chameleon Seraph, transcended her physical limitations and ascended to an Archailect. Recognizing the potential of the O'Neill cylinder as a nexus for spiritual and technological growth, she became a pivotal force in its creation, ensuring that her teachings of adaptability and evolution became the foundation of this new realm.
==Colonel==
[[File:The Colonel.png|right|200px|thumb|The Colonel]]
{{Quote|The first part of the poem describes the ambush of the Seven-Coils by a warrior 'scarred all over by the traitor gods, scarred even unto his eyes, so that the sight of the great coils would not destroy him'.|''Medusa's Lament''}}
'''The Colonel''', also called '''The Cartographer of Scars,''' '''The Tribune of Scars''', '''The Scarred Captain''', '''The Thousandman''', and '''The Chiliarch''', is one of the [[Hours]], associated with hour VII, or 7:00am. His [[Aspects]] are {{Lore|Edge}}, {{Lore|Winter}}, and {{Lore|Lantern}}. He is notorious for being scarred all over his body, such that he is blind and deaf. This does not impair his lethality in the slightest; he is so potent that the other [[Hours]] appointed him to defend and maintain [[Way: The Peacock's Door#The Worm Museum|The Worm Museum]], and his scars make him impossible to wound. He is associated with the scents of gunpowder and snow.

The Colonel is one of the Gods-from-Flesh, and was once a mortal. According to some sources he aided in the founding of Mycenae by killing the God-from-Stone called [[The Seven-Coils]]. According to ''[[The Sevenfold Slaying of the Seven-Coiled]],'' The Colonel gained his first scars (including those that made him blind) to protect him from the sight of The Seven-Coils. It was apparently by killing The Seven-Coils that he ascended to become an Hour.

Later, he would tutor and be betrayed by [[The Lionsmith]], setting off a cosmic rivalry known as the Corrivalry. In this rivalry, the Colonel prefers patience and cunning, and he favors those who promote the political status quo and betray revolutions. The Colonel is the protector of [[Foe|The Foe]], and his Names may include [[Biedde's Blade|Biedde]] and Quirinus. [[Lalla Chaima, the Huntress]] is among the Colonel's devotees. In the Exile legacy, it is possible to dedicate oneself to the Colonel and ascend into his service, forever playing out the Corrivalry with the Foe.  

The Colonel is mentioned in the book ''[[The Victory of Crowns]]'' as being the master of various cults of assassins who have hunted, killed, and consumed [[Long|immortal beings]] throughout history. One of these was called the Tragulari, or more commonly the Dartsmen, and they were wiped out by the Troissant Company after the First [[Worms|Worm]] War in at least one History. 

The Colonel is worshipped by militaristic cults across Europe and the Near East. These cults disguise themselves with the appearance of conventional religion. Shrines to him are found in [[Candia-Heraklion]], [[Stalingrad]], [[Leningrad]], [[Nizhny Novgorod]], [[Munich]], [[Rhenish Aachen]], and [[Valletta]]. [[Crowkiss Hill]] contains the corpse of a heavily scarred warrior-king who was probably one of the Colonel's devotees.

== Attributes ==
*** Color-changing Aura: The Seraph’s presence is marked by its ever-changing hues, reflecting its environment and the energies within.
*** Multi-dimensional Perception: Ability to perceive across multiple dimensions simultaneously, guiding adventurers through realms known and unknown.
*** Fluid Form: Manifesting in forms that best resonate with the lessons she wishes to convey.

== Role in the Wave Blade Forest ==
Intrinsically linked to the Wave Blade Forest, the Chameleon Seraph guides adventurers through its delicate dance. As its guardian spirit, she personifies the essence of adaptability and metamorphosis, ensuring that visitors learn to move in harmony with the forest's rhythms.

== Teachings ==
The Seraph's teachings, rooted in her human experiences and evolution, emphasize:
*** Embracing change and adapting rather than resisting.
*** Recognizing life's transitory nature and the unending cycle of transformation.
*** Understanding challenges as gateways to growth.

== Blessings ==
To those who prove their resilience and understanding, the Seraph grants:
*** Boon of Adaptation: A gift of rapid acclimatization to challenges, both environmental and emotional.
*** Vision of Change: Glimpses of possible futures to aid in decision-making.
*** Aura Sync: Temporary alignment of one's aura with surroundings, rendering them nearly invisible.

== Legacy ==
The Chameleon Seraph stands as a beacon of hope and evolution. Through guiding souls in the Wave Blade Forest, she imparts the wisdom of her journey from a curious human to a divine Archailect, underscoring the potential within everyone to transcend and evolve.[[Category:Oldest pages before the refresh]]
